definition: Median of five independent trials. Editing repeated phase uses the median of seven events within each trial, then five trial medians. min/max are trial-level. Difference verdict is descriptive with max(1ms,10% baseline) noise guard, not statistical significance. Time reduction applies only to time metrics; rects excluded. No overall average improvement.
